summary: B004 now describes multiple mutant alleles in founder #30 and distinguishes the author-manuscript count of five from the six entries in publisher Figure 3C.

edits.before: Tyr4a, Tyr4b, and Cas9 RNAs were introduced into zygotes. Tail-DNA analysis identified five mutant alleles in completely albino hybrid founder #30. The authors attribute the within-founder diversity to mosaicism, potentially arising from editing that persisted into cleavage stages. Deep sequencing reported 57 mutant alleles meeting its read-frequency threshold across 23 hybrid founders; these are not 57 injected animals.
